items.text: The best career skills to learn in your 30s are those that extend what you already know, such as people management, data literacy, communication and domain depth, and the right pick depends on whether you want promotion, a switch or an independent practice.
Name the next role you want, learn the one or two skills it needs and prove them with a project at work.
Verify outcomes with alumni and avoid paying for guarantees.
